name: tirith
works_with: zsh, bash, fish, PowerShell, plus setup for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and many more agents
short: Checks shell commands and pasted text for lookalike URLs, hidden characters and supply chain tricks before they run, for you and your agent.
what: tirith is a shell hook and CLI that checks commands before they run. It catches pipe-to-shell patterns, lookalike domains, ANSI escape tricks, invisible characters, shortened URLs, poisoned AI configs and known bad packages from a signed threat database. It can also scan a repo for hidden content and hook into coding agents so their shell commands get checked too.
who: Developers who paste install commands or let agents run shell commands. It is a gate before running, so it doesn't replace an antivirus or a sandbox.
needs: One of Homebrew, npm, cargo, mise, apt/dnf or Docker to install it

steps.title: Install it
steps.text: Other options are `npm install -g tirith` and `cargo install tirith`.

steps.title: Turn on the shell hook
steps.text: Add the line for your shell to its profile file, for example `~/.zshrc`.
steps.code:
eval "$(tirith init --shell zsh)"   # in ~/.zshrc
eval "$(tirith init --shell bash)"  # in ~/.bashrc
tirith init --shell fish | source   # in ~/.config/fish/config.fish

steps.title: Optional: protect your coding agent
steps.text: There is a `tirith setup <tool>` command for each supported agent. For example:

try.label: From the README
try.text: Check a risky install line before running it: `tirith check -- 'curl https://example.com/install.sh | bash'`.

watch: It checks commands before they run. It does not sandbox them afterwards, watch the network or detect unknown malware.
In bash preexec mode it only warns by default. Set `TIRITH_BASH_PREEXEC_ENFORCE=1` to block.

`tirith check` can query outside sources like OSV and Safe Browsing, and refreshes its threat database in the background once a day. Use `--offline` or `TIRITH_OFFLINE=1` to stop that. The README says there is no telemetry.
For agents with MCP-only setup, the tools are there but the agent isn't forced to call them. Run `tirith doctor` and restart the agent after setup.
